app_title: DMD GIF Creator 128x32 - AI Enhanced v3.2.1
restart_required: Please restart the application to apply the new language.
tooltip_pixel_perfect: Forces an integer scale factor and simulates the physical LED render in previews (spaced round dots, instead of a simple square upscale).
tooltip_letter_threshold: Minimum letter height (in pixels after resizing) below which text is judged unreadable and Fill/scroll mode is forced instead of Resize.
tooltip_scroll_speed: Scroll speed in pixels/frame for Fill mode. Below 1, frames are repeated to simulate slower-than-one-pixel scrolling.
tooltip_add_folder: Adds an entire folder (always scanned recursively, including subfolders).
tooltip_add_images: Adds one or several individual image files.
tooltip_reauthorize: Re-authorizes an image already marked as exported, allowing it to be processed again in a batch.
tooltip_tolerance: Color-matching sensitivity for the fill and magic eraser tools (0 = exact color only, 100 = every color).
tooltip_loop_mode: Normal: plays once. Ping-pong: plays forward then backward. Infinite: repeats continuously.
tooltip_easing: Changes the relative playback speed of the animation (speeds up/slows down the start or end) without changing the frame count or duration.
tooltip_bounce_edges: The sequence goes back and forth instead of stopping or looping abruptly at the end, within the same total duration.
tooltip_color_effect: Only active when Effect is set to "normal" — has no effect with the other styles (3d, fire, neon...).
tooltip_led_brightness: Simulates the LED panel's physical brightness: brighter pushes colors toward white and increases the glow bloom, dimmer darkens and reduces the glow. 50% = neutral render.
tooltip_led_zoom: Opens an enlarged, animated view of the current LED render (only available when DMD mode / pixel-perfect is checked).
video_no_cv2: ⚠️ opencv-contrib-python not installed — pip install opencv-contrib-python
tooltip_video_roi: In "✋ Manual" mode, click "➕ Point here" then draw a rectangle over the area to frame: it is set as a point on the timeline automatically on release. Click-drag inside the rectangle already shown to move it (live preview).
tooltip_video_crop_mode_tracking: A single rectangle, drawn once: a tracker (OpenCV) follows it automatically over the whole video to keep the subject in frame. No manual repositioning, no multi-point system; crop size computed automatically.
tooltip_video_crop_mode_auto_zoom: You position the framing yourself (drag the rectangle), but its size is computed automatically. No auto-tracking, no multi-point system — a single framing, movable at any time.
tooltip_video_crop_mode_manual: No automation: combine the point system ("➕ Point here"/"🔍 Zoom here", several zones and zoom levels over time) with the "Framing zoom" slider, entirely by hand.
tooltip_video_roi_edit_time: The cyan line/triangle is the framing time: drag it (without changing the trim selection) to navigate through the video and view/edit the active framing point at that instant. Use "➕ Point here" to set a new framing point, "🔍 Zoom here" for a zoom point, on the graphical timeline just below the filmstrip.
tooltip_video_playback: Looping preview of the source video (resized to fit). Click to open it full-size in the system's default player.
tooltip_video_add_roi_point: Clears the rectangle shown and waits for a new drawing over the area to track: draw it on the canvas, it is set automatically as a manual point on release, at the current framing time. Replaces the existing point if one is already very close.
tooltip_video_add_zoom_point: Sets a zoom point at the current framing time, with the current value of the "Framing zoom" slider — independent from framing points, interpolated over time once 2+ points are set.
tooltip_video_delete_roi_point: Deletes the point (framing or zoom, whichever is closer in time) nearest to the current framing time. "🗑️ Clear points" resets everything at once.
tooltip_video_events_timeline: Timeline of the points placed: orange disc = auto-tracking point, purple square = manual point, teal diamond = zoom point. Click-drag a point to move it in time.

t_fill_on: Fill mode on - Click an area
t_eraser_on: Magic eraser on - Click to erase
tooltip_fill_ratio: Checked: scrolling (Fill) is forced when the logo, transparent margins removed, is at least N times wider than tall. Nothing is cropped: the whole logo goes across the screen. Unchecked: Resize or Fill is chosen by score.
tooltip_review: Opens the list of GIFs from the last batch, sorted from lowest to highest quality score, with LED preview (“Other folder…” in the window to review another one). Lets you move (never delete) GIFs below a threshold to the _a_revoir folder.
t_review_pick_folder: Folder of GIFs to review (containing dmd_scores.json)
t_review_no_index:
No scores in this folder ({name}).
First batch-process images into this folder.
t_review_offer:
{n} GIFs have a poor or bad score.
Open the “Review” window?
tooltip_profile: Generation profile: sets the global parameters and the options below. “Generic”: no limits, for any use. “Recalbox logos”: logos shown while browsing. “DMD playlist”: DMD settings with a higher frame rate for smoother motion. Everything can still be changed by hand; ➕ creates your own profile.
tooltip_profile_save: Saves the current settings (global parameters + options) into this profile (profiles.json in the configuration folder).
tooltip_invert_dark: A dark, nearly monochrome logo on a transparent background (e.g. black text meant for a light background) is invisible on the DMD: the tool also tries its inverted version and keeps it only if the quality score clearly improves.
tooltip_scroll_cap: Maximum duration of one scrolling round trip. Beyond it, scrolling is sped up (more pixels per frame, same frame rate), without cropping anything. Unchecked: no limit.
tooltip_profile_new: Opens the profile creation page, pre-filled with the current settings.
tooltip_profile_delete: Deletes this custom profile, or resets a built-in profile to its original values.
t_profile_new_prompt: Profile name (created from the current settings):
t_profile_reset_confirm: Reset profile “{name}” to its original values?
tooltip_profile_edit: Opens the page of the selected profile: all its parameters, each explained.
tooltip_pe_fps: Frames per second of the GIF. Higher = smoother motion, but a heavier file and faster scrolling (scrolling moves one step per frame). Values validated on the panel: 15 fps for logos while browsing, 20 fps in playlist.
tooltip_pe_duration: Minimum duration of the GIF. A shorter animation is repeated until it reaches it, and a still logo is shown for this duration. Does not lengthen a longer scroll.
tooltip_pe_contrast: Base contrast. AUTO mode then tries variants around this value (×0.9, ×1, ×1.15, then ±15 % refinement) and keeps the best.
tooltip_pe_saturation: Base colour saturation. AUTO mode then refines it by ±15 % if the result improves.
tooltip_pe_color_count: Maximum number of colours in the GIF palette, used when the source image has more than 16 (an 8- or 16-colour source automatically keeps 8 or 16). Fewer colours = lighter file.
tooltip_fix_button: For each GIF scoring ≤ threshold, tries fixes of the source image (empty space removed, gamma, levels, dark parts lightened, inversion) with the batch settings, and suggests the best ones. Nothing changes without your approval; an accepted original is set aside in _a_revoir/_avant_correction.

t_fix_no_job: No source image found for these GIFs.

tooltip_review_edit: Opens this GIF's source image in the MANUAL tab, with the GIF's timing (FPS, duration, batch loop). On export, the application offers to replace this GIF in the batch folder; the original is set aside in _a_revoir/_avant_correction.
t_review_edit_replace:
Replace {rel} in the batch folder?

Yes: the original is set aside in {dir} (never deleted).
No: save elsewhere.
t_crop_status: Frame {w}×{h} px ({k} px per LED) at ({x}, {y}) — drag to move, wheel = size, arrows = 1 px (Shift: 10), double-click or Enter = apply, Escape = cancel
tooltip_manual_zoom: Enlarges or shrinks the logo on the panel, from 50 % to 300 %. 100 % = size computed automatically for 128×32. Above, the logo overflows and scrolls longer; below, it is smaller and centered. The working image is not modified.
tooltip_zone: Limits effects to part of the image: draw a rectangle, drag inside it to move it. While a zone exists, sliders and filters only affect its content (Rotate 90° always turns the whole image).
tooltip_zone_clear: Clears the zone: effects apply to the whole image again.
t_zone_cleared: Zone cleared: effects on the whole image
t_zone_hint: Zone: draw a rectangle (drag), drag inside it to move it; sliders and filters only affect the zone. Escape or ▭ Zone = done
t_batch_workers_note: Batch computations run at low priority: the PC stays usable during processing. {cpu} logical cores on this PC.
tooltip_batch_workers: Number of images processed at the same time by batch processing (and by the Review window fixes). Auto = logical cores minus 2, at most 12: beyond 12, the measured gain is only 6 %. Fewer cores = slower batch but a more available PC.
